title: Support a per-model input context window override for custom gateways

labels.name: status/need-triage
labels.description: Issues that need to be triaged by the triage automation.

body:
Custom model gateways can advertise their actual context window, but `packages/core/src/core/tokenLimits.ts` currently gives every unknown model `DEFAULT_TOKEN_LIMIT` (1,048,576). The function accepts only the model name. The documented `modelConfigs` settings allow generation settings such as `maxOutputTokens`, without an input context-window override.

We encountered this while fixing https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/issues/1582. Our symbolic server derives its context capacity from available resources and publishes `context_window_tokens` through its model metadata. Assuming the fixed Gemini window can trigger premature compaction when the server supports more, or allow a larger context than a smaller server supports.

Reproduction against the current source (not an installed CLI end-to-end test):

1. Configure a custom gateway/model named `formal-ai` whose advertised input window is 1,234,567 tokens.
2. Evaluate `tokenLimit('formal-ai')` from `packages/core/src/core/tokenLimits.ts`.
3. It returns 1,048,576 regardless of the gateway's advertised value. The `default` branch cannot receive an override.

Expected: a validated per-model input context-window setting, optionally populated from gateway model discovery. Existing Gemini model defaults should remain the fallback when no override is supplied.

Suggested change: add an optional positive integer `contextWindowTokens` to model configuration, resolve it alongside the existing model-specific generation configuration, and pass it to the token-budget/compaction code before falling back to `tokenLimit(model)`. Reject invalid/non-finite values and test both values below and above 1,048,576. Do not infer an unlimited context from a model name.

Current workaround: use a client exposing an actual context-window override, or keep the gateway within the fixed window while accepting the reduced capacity. `maxOutputTokens` alone cannot fix the input budget. We have not patched installed Gemini packages or claimed this workaround satisfies our all-clients acceptance criterion.
